title: Video by adamstewartmarketing
description:
Comment “EDIT” and I’ll send you my workflow.

This video was edited 100% with GPT-6 Astra in Codex.

I gave it my footage, a reference video and instructions. It cut the pauses, added captions, built the animations and brought in real OpenAI demo footage.

Then I kept refining it with prompts:
 “Tighter pacing.”  “Use the real logos.”  “Make the animations better.”
 I even edited this from my phone by prompting Codex.
 I recommend running it on a Mac Mini or another computer you can remote into. Your computer handles the editing and rendering while you send prompts and review the results from wherever you are. 
I’ve put the setup and copy-and-paste prompts into a simple guide so you can try it with your own footage.
 #chatgpt #dots #astra #gpt6 #openai
